notes.title: Patch #11 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/c7292afd7cd8940b17275504813cd1774133a67f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Shortly after deploying our latest patch, we identified an issue that blocked some players from receiving weekly quest rewards as well as a camera shake that caused nausea. notes.title: Patch #10 - German Localization, Bug Fixes, and Improvements
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/afeff565d0a33eb9f465776fea27f923f7f1a090.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’re back for another update full of bug fixes, improvements and one of our very first [b]localization patches![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/354c6652019217af627bece1f8ab73741d5bc0aa.png"][/img][/p][p][b]German Localization:[/b] We prioritized localization after seeing how active our fledgling German community was. This update introduces the first of our translations: German![/p][list][*][p][b]Language Setting:[/b] You can now select which language you’d prefer to play with by heading to your Settings menu and choosing between English and German. (It will also automatically select German depending on your OS settings.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Support Resources:[/b] If you need help, we’re ready and waiting! [url="https://equinoxgame.zendesk.com/hc/de"][u]Our Zendesk[/u][/url] has a new German localization and Miriam, our German customer support agent will be here for you in our support queue. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Two New Hairstyles:[/b] Parted Messy and Buzzcut are new options you can select in the character creator.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/af07abbecfe6871757e51abe7eb8f3df120ac561.gif"][/img][/p][p]To celebrate the release of our first localization, we’ve partnered up with [url="https://www.youtube.com/@kaddigaming"][u]Kaddi Gaming[/u][/url]! Catch the replay of their livestream at the top of our Steam page this weekend or directly on her channels.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/c9a947b198a7e89e2d8fcfdab84512f34e659c19.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/33f2022cae811c9ed22ee5e191585bb36676321e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Compendium Improvements:[/b] We’ve added two new sections to the Compendium to help you keep track of all your ongoing quests and goals…[/p][list][*][p][b]Tutorials:[/b] A new category has been added to the Compendium to store all previously completed Tutorials! This lets you go back and check on previous instructions and guides.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Races:[/b] See which tracks are available, what your latest times were, when your Weekly Race limit will reset, and how many Weekly Races you’ve completed in the brand new Race Compendium tab.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weekly Tasks Moved to Phone:[/b] We’ve moved Weekly Tasks away from the Compendium; now they can be found in the new Phone UI tab dedicated to Weekly Tasks. This new section lets you see when your Weekly Tasks will reset, review which Tasks are available, and accept new Tasks.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/fcc8b29b6d653682406abe39b448557cff3ca1f6.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Art Polish:[/b] We are always refining our animations, seeking to optimize the game to improve performance, and tweaking our game’s art. These are some of the larger changes this update introduces…[/p][list][*][p][b]Child Animations:[/b] Zoe, one of the NPCs you encounter in later chapters, now has custom animations! [i](As a child, she uses a different model and rig than other NPcs which means she needed custom-made animations.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Improvements:[/b] Several areas around the island have been spruced up with new set dressing items such as Mike’s Farm, the Equestrian Center, the Riding Hall, and Paige’s House. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Downtown Performance Updates:[/b] We’ve improved the performance of areas around Downtown Alderwood to help ease the load. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Handfeeding:[/b] We’ve kicked the bucket to the curb! Now when you give your horse treats, it will be by hand. We’re looking to polish this, so please let us know your thoughts.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/43c549ebb512a9c2db38034a2673865f98751d53.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2dd6671b79c35d4964929a143347cba503b9fc4d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Players have discovered several areas that they can become stuck in due to environmental jumping. We’ve tracked everyone’s reports and have attempted to fix as many of these navmesh issues as possible. [/p][/*][*][p]Players who completed Father and Son Part 1 [i]before[/i] our hotfix in Patch #9 were unable to start Part 2. For this subset of players, now after interacting with Jett again, the second part of the quest will trigger after a couple hours have passed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several cases of collectibles such as mushrooms or fossils being invisible to players and covered by terrain. [/p][/*][*][p]Zoe now walks during the quest in Chapter 2. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Club Leaders could leave a club without naming a successor.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a visual bug that caused text messages to overlap on the scrollbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Map Waypoints associated with Wasp Emergency and Wasp Attack will now disappear as intended upon completion. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where reflections in the caves did not render correctly when playing on low quality settings.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch #9 - Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Our latest patch was full of new content and updates! Unfortunately it caused a few new bugs to pop up... But today we're deploying a hotfix to resolve those issues. Our servers will be down temporarily beginning Aug. 19th at 5pm CEST until 5:45pm while we deploy the patch. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/94df524c6ed1d7f1ee7d40ebe1b65b35cc9d6efc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2dd6671b79c35d4964929a143347cba503b9fc4d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Early Access currency would not display in your inventory after completing your Weekly Goals until you restarted the game. Now after you complete your Weekly Goal you will immediately see the purple EA Currency in your inventory.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/af9bc9983398caa64549dc396ea26f77f6d4d102.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented users from starting Part 2 of the Father and Son quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused items assigned to your Cosmetic slot to provide bonus stats.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/33f2022cae811c9ed22ee5e191585bb36676321e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Cosmetic Slots:[/b] No need to sacrifice stats for fashion anymore! There are two new options in the Gear inventory![/p][list][*][p]You can now "Equip Gear" to retain an item's stat bonus. [/p][/*][*][p]You can "Assign Cosmetic" to keep item's visuals [i]without[/i] retaining the stat bonuses. [/p][/*][/list][p]Now you can have your cake and eat it too: enjoy the stats from one item while looking fabulous. 💅🏼[/p]

notes.title: Patch #8 - Ch. 3, Environmental Jumping, and Control Customization
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/e8cd0df4f780dba4840813600f331eaeb7d3972b.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re back from summer vacation and excited to push out our newest patch! This update brings the next chapter in our narrative campaign, a new earnable loyalty currency just for Early Access players, a whole slew of customization options, and last but not least [b]environmental jumping.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/3fe02195dfe46206afbe2a593b4778f69bba8766.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/354c6652019217af627bece1f8ab73741d5bc0aa.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Chapter 3:[/b] Continue your investigation and unearth inexplicable clues in our newest chapter. Can you find a reasonable explanation or is there really something supernatural at work here?[/p][p][i]Please note that we do not have any new cutscenes yet but that the team is hard at work producing them![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/22e9d2190f52fdb9d08f1727b16323782ee378d7.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]New Quest Content:[/b] In total this patch brings players a whole bunch of new content to experience:[/p][list][*][p]8 main quests[/p][/*][*][p]6 side quests[/p][/*][*][p]10 new weeklies added to the pool[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2bddb02bd6834b86fa1c7104ae8f662ef5c8eb83.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]New Riding Island - Sunset Lake:[/b] This hidden gem is the darling of the archipelago and inspired by the stunning summer views we enjoy in Sweden! This trail winds around a beautiful azure lake with plenty of cozy nooks, forest trails, and beaches.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/33f2022cae811c9ed22ee5e191585bb36676321e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/cfb85c893591d06be1771f47c161176fd95c9ef3.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Custom Control Settings[/b]: We’re happy to announce new, much requested settings have been added to the game! Now players can customize their camera and keyboard settings. To do so, please press “Esc”, navigate to the “Options” menu, and select the fifth icon.[/p][list][*][p][b]Key Bindings: [/b]Now you can review and set custom key bindings for your mouse and keyboard. (Please note that you must be in-game for the menu to work.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Customization:[/b] In the same menu you can adjust camera sensitivity, orientation, and inversion. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/bd85dbbcce7b54e091bfac4c4543565ef43de1bc.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Subtitles:[/b] As soon as we realized how important subtitles were for our community, we reprioritized them so that we could get them into the game ASAP.[/p][list][*][p][b]English subtitles:[/b] Moving forward, we have automatically enabled English subtitles for all of our cutscenes!  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization support[/b]: Adding a single language’s worth of subtitles is one thing, but we want to work smarter. As we worked on subtitles, we also made sure to set up our systems to support future localizations and make that process easier… Stay tuned for more info on upcoming translations![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Completed Quests:[/b] The Compendium has a new category for “Completed Quests” where you can review what you’ve done so far.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/43cbfa5ebecf85ac20fe8b8ebc1658f395d8fb46.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Environmental Jumping:[/b] This update also introduces another suggestion from our community: jumping over obstacles outside of races! The first public iteration of free range jumping is enabled, which means you can clear minor obstacles like low-lying fences, trees, and minor cliffs.  [/p][p][i]“As a first iteration, we expect there to be some proverbial rough edges. That might mean you can jump into some unusual spots or even get stuck. While we have tried to ensure that this isn't the case, the islands are large and we are sure the intrepid adventurers amongst you will find those spots! If you do, or if you have feedback, please [b]let us know by using the in-game bug reporting feature[/b].[/i][/p][p][i]“Getting mounted traversal right is one of our core goals. We want your feedback on this feature and combined with our continued animation updates. So go out and explore and let us know what you think!” [/i]- Craig Morrison, Studio Creative Director[/p][p][/p][p][b]Loyalty Currency:[/b] We have added a new currency that you can get after completing your weekly goals. This is a special reward for folks who play during the Early Access period! You’ll be able to earn one each week and this currency will not be reset during testing. Eventually there will be exclusive Early Access only cosmetic items available for you to purchase with this currency.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/af9bc9983398caa64549dc396ea26f77f6d4d102.png"][/img]In addition to the reset scheduled to happen before our 1.0 launch, for balance and testing reasons, we will likely need to reset other currencies at various points during Early Access. This currency is immune to that! It's a feature we added to recognize and reward players like you: the ones who are spending time playing, growing the community, and providing us with valuable feedback during our Early Access period. Thank you! 🥰[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/01331c36781da6571aadc96971a1eef239993e3b.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2dd6671b79c35d4964929a143347cba503b9fc4d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Alfred no longer has a doppelganger clone appear during “Postman Duties”. (Sorry folks, this isn’t The Prestige!)[/p][/*][*][p]Forest traps in quests such as “Deer Trail Danger” now react appropriately (e.g. light up and make a pinging sound) when using the Investigation mechanic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where quest markers were not appearing in several quests such as “Meet the Lighthouse Keeper”, “Poacher’s Alert”, and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusting the voice volume setting now properly affects voice over lines that play during emotes and mounting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various typos and grammatical errors in the Compendium and quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a level of detail bug that caused the Bob and Bangs hairstyle to stretch when viewed from a distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a problem in “Not so Sharp” where Nina’s knives used the incorrect Egg icon. Goodbye my beloved knife egg~[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/dbdea16e28af9467b11a862f5d8fe298e5700cad.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/51cc4fbf519668bd387a61204fd8dc49315b9302.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]There are several quests across Ch. 2 and 3 that rely on the Investigation Mechanic. There is no reminder to do so, so please try to remember that you can search for clues by using the “F” key.[/p][/*][*][p]This is our first iteration of environmental jumping. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please let us know by reporting in game![/p][/*][*][p]The map for the new Sunset Lake riding island has inaccurate labels.[/p][/*][*][p]It is not possible to customize key bindings in the main menu; you must enter the game to do so.[/p][/*][*][p]After completing your weekly goals, your new purple EA currency doesn't appear in your inventory until you restart your game.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/743f517a1170b06d629959cb33082b56282206b0.png"][/img][/p][p]Did you know you can report bugs and feedback while in game? This is our preferred method of reporting because it automatically attaches logs for us! If you encounter any jumping problems and report it in game, we’ll get your coordinate info automatically so our team knows [b][i]exactly[/i][/b] where the problem occurred.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/0380bae58cfbc555f6532b7675a3f200d9f39eeb.gif"][/img][/p][p]So how do you report in-game issues?[/p][olist][*][p]Press ESC to open the Options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Select the headset icon to open up the Reporting and Support menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Select “Bug Report”.[/p][/*][*][p]Fill out the Bug or Feedback reporting form.[/p][/*][*][p]When you’re done, click that you agree to the privacy policy and send![/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Summer 2025 Pub Crawl
notes.content:
[p]We may be in Early Access, but that doesn’t mean we can’t live it up a bit! [/p][p][/p][p]Scattered across Alderwood and the Ride Islands are [b]6 packs of beer[/b] that the inhabitants have left lying around. notes.title: Patch #7 - Emotes, New Items, & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/1b114f190a0eeb4df70335d49bd0fc0479739a64.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our newest patch ticks off one of our promised roadmap features: our Emote System. It also includes a whole slew of bug fixes and improvements: in total, we’ve fixed over 100 issues for this patch! 
[/p][p]Our team will be taking some much needed vacation over the next few weeks, so things may feel a little slower until mid-August. We’ll still have some folks around available to answer questions, handle our official Support queue, and of course continue developing the game.
[/p][p]So what’s next? We’ve been working hard on new content like our upcoming chapter, another riding island as well as animation polish, optimization, and new quests.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/354c6652019217af627bece1f8ab73741d5bc0aa.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/f3c3b39ef7430b6bfcfdcb916383547449c1ee9a.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Emote System:[/b] Our first batch of emotes are now live! These can be accessed by pressing “R”.[/p][list][*][p]You can finally[b] Pet your horse! [/b][/p][/*][*][p]Find a jokester on the island? [b]Laugh [/b]at their antics![/p][/*][*][p][b]Clap [/b]to show you’re impressed.[/p][/*][*][p]Want to celebrate? Share a [b]High Five[/b] with others.[/p][/*][*][p]Show that hospitable Alderwood spirit by [b]Waving[/b] to new and old friends.[/p][/*][*][p]Feeling down in the dumps over a lost race? Let others know with the [b]Sad [/b]emote.[/p][/*][/list][p]While on horseback you can wave and pet your horse. Other emotes are available while dismounted. Now that the Emote System is working, we’re looking forward to adding more in upcoming updates.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/d37f4fbfc887ea29da1d99f71cf5bf2f5db7c605.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Texting and Riding:[/b] On horseback you can now steer while you have your phone open. You can do this by holding the right mouse button.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New items[/b] like hats, helmets, bridles, saddles, and blankets have been added to shops across the island![/p][list][*][p]Cowboy Hats are located at the Blacksmith.[/p][/*][*][p]Beanies are located in Hook’s End.[/p][/*][*][p]English Helmets are available in Downtown Alderwood.[/p][/*][*][p]Ball Caps can be purchased at the Farmer’s Market in Downtown Alderwood.[/p][/*][*][p]Modern Saddles can be purchased from the Farmer’s Market in Downtown Alderwood.[/p][/*][*][p]New bridles can be purchased from various locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Western blanket pads are located at the Blacksmith.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Please note that hats and helmets are cosmetic only i.e. they do not have stats.[/i]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/33f2022cae811c9ed22ee5e191585bb36676321e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/99f19c1bd4b4ef06bcb3ae5c7da20a1e10cc2134.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Collecting items from horseback in all slower gaits (aside from sprinting!) is now easier to do.[/p][/*][*][p]The UI and widget for Horse Needs has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Farrier and Vendor menus have had their usability and UI improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio settings now include a numeric description of the volume sliders.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest dialogue, especially for Chapter 2, has been improved and polished.[/p][/*][*][p]New set dressing has been added to various houses and special surroundings around Alderwood Island.[/p][/*][*][p]Various environmental art improvements have been made to eliminate broken textures, floating assets, or model issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Horse animations continue to be improved, specifically for jumping and the neck.[/p][/*][*][p]New options in the graphics menu! Several anti-aliasing modes (TAA, TSR, DLSS, DLAA) and ability to fine tune TSR and DLSS.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/3d904780fc728d586a40cf1b5c46a7a896085ce1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2dd6671b79c35d4964929a143347cba503b9fc4d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Phone usability has been improved now that multiple bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Players in town will no longer hear SFX from other players’ horses.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest details display in the correct ratio now when viewed while the map is open.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will not be stuck during the Poacher’s Alert.[/p][/*][*][p]Artifacts for Alfred can now be found. [/p][/*][*][p]Clubs no longer can have identical names; all clubs must have unique names.[/p][/*][*][p]The ([b]spoiler warning: Ch. 1[/b]) \[spoiler]corrupted animals in Kyle’s hut\[/spoiler] now remain on the ground when completing the quest.[/p][/*][*][p]High Coast Trail, the newest riding island, now has a freshly baked nav mesh. Enjoy the collision![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/51cc4fbf519668bd387a61204fd8dc49315b9302.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]During Poachers Alert's "Go to Kyle" step, the map marker is not appearing. We believe this can be worked around by travelling to the [url="https://discord.com/channels/1353823959468081223/1392430763512823922"]location shown in these screenshots.[/url][/p][/*][*][p]A small number of players have had their horse's coat pattern changed due to a database error. Unfortunately we're unable to resolve this issue without causing more severe issues to occur. If you want your old markings back, please reset your character. You can [url="https://discord.com/channels/1353823959468081223/1392431975301775420"]read more details here.[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch #6 - Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/d8029eef3357f4fe905520ab7d819084e230ec81.png"][/img][/p][p]This hotfix is being deployed to fix several issues related to crashes and quests being blocked from completion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2dd6671b79c35d4964929a143347cba503b9fc4d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Weeklies Unlocking:[/b] Fixed an issue that caused returning users to not receive new Weeklies upon unlocking them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Declined Quests Can Be Accepted Later:[/b] Amulet Hunt can now be accepted even after initially declining the quest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Emily's Flower Quests:[/b] Emily should be appearing now for her associated flower quests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crash:[/b] Fixed an infinite loop crash that affected some users in the middle of the Amulet Hunt quest.[/p][/*][/list][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/4990166f78b027462dcd5b61ebc658dc9dada05f.png"][/img][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/9ccb52b8e100390a551b995a3d19c862eba5038b.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Anyone else excited to pet their horse? [/i]👀[/p][p]The rest of the team is hard at work on our upcoming Summer patches. We'll be releasing new content and our upcoming emote system soon! Read about our entire [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3258290/announcements/detail/528722773603779272"]roadmap here.[/url] ✨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/eb6e968a471b97b941040dc427055608dd61a424.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch #5 - Chapter 2, New Content, and More!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/8ec8945dbf635e2f672137ae73a1d85e826301bb.png"][/img] Our fifth patch is the biggest yet: chock full of content like new quests, chapter 2, races, and a new ride island. All in all, the team completed over [b]150 fixes and tickets[/b] in preparation for this patch. A lot of these were implementation tasks for the wealth of new content, so these patch notes are going to focus on the highlights.  [/p][p]Note that for [b]this[/b] chapter release, all player quest progression will be wiped. You will keep things like inventory, faction levels, etc. Future chapter releases [b]will not require[/b] a quest progression reset![/p][p]  [/p][p]As always, we’re looking forward to hearing your feedback - especially on our new story content! Preparations are already well underway for our next patch. Without further ado, here’s our change log! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/354c6652019217af627bece1f8ab73741d5bc0aa.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Riding Island - High Coast Trail:[/b] Take an adventure to the high coastal mountains! Navigate a series of switchbacks and relax after your descent next to a secluded spot on the charming coast.[/p][list][*][p]Please note the island currently doesn’t have nav mesh or proper collision. This will be fixed in the next immediate patch![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/1f83451b309fd2a8bc68b4fd4b6ebc66d4e60615.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Chapter 2: [/b]Continue your investigation with the newest chapter! Sarah sends you an invite you can’t refuse as you both retrace Jenny’s final steps…
[/p][p][b]New Quest Content:[/b] The team has been hard at work implementing new content for our players to experience. In total, this update brings you: [/p][list][*][p][b]15 main quests[/b] [/p][/*][*][p][b]13 side quests[/b] [/p][/*][*][p][b]25 new weeklies [/b]have been added to the pool.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Races:[/b] Two new races have been added.[/p][list][*][p][b]Alderwood Lap[/b]: Race through the town through picturesque seaside trails and across the tracks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fisherman’s Folly:[/b] Take a ride through the winding beach trails full of challenging jumps and loop back around into the village.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/797c5a2b12ed3296b2826f7b44eecca956ec9049.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Daily Gifting for NPCs:[/b] People on the island are looking for specific items that you may run across in your adventure. Why not try giving them a gift? You’ll be able to increase faction reputation by completing their daily gift requests!
[/p][p][b]Farrier Upgrade System:[/b] You can now visit the Farrier and pay to upgrade the stats on your equipment! Note that you cannot upgrade [b]all [/b]items at the Farrier, only certain items are eligible. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/4009de01e656f927958699b686d2ff4830dd03a1.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/33f2022cae811c9ed22ee5e191585bb36676321e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Shader Loading Bar:[/b] The main menu now has a loading bar to display shader progress. Note that entering the game before it's finished results in graphical and performance issues.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Tool Tips:[/b] Map locations have tool tips.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Experience Notifications:[/b] Player riders and horses now receive experience notifications.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Username Phone Search:[/b] Players can search for friends by username via your phone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Entries:[/b] Compendium and Journal entries have been added for the new content.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Quest Save System:[/b] It has been reworked to be more flexible and stable.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Animation & Graphic Polish:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rider’s reins in hands are better blended with the horse now.[/p][/*][*][p]Transition issues while reverse riding in a circle has been made smoother. The horse will no longer snap its head repeatedly.[/p][/*][*][p]Lights and Dynamic Sky have been adjusted allowing for improved performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2dd6671b79c35d4964929a143347cba503b9fc4d.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Crash and Stability Fixes:[/b] We have continued to improve stability and fixed a variety of crash related issues.[b] [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Flower Basket Can Be Completed:[/b] Players can now ‘Speak with Emily’ to complete the ‘Flower Basket’ quest.[/p][list][*][p][i]This fix required reworking the “Flower Basket” quest; it is now five “different” quests named Aqua Beauty, Crimson Beauty, Sunshine Beauty, Moonlight Beauty, and Soothing Beauty.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Player Barn Icon Stays:[/b] The player barn icon no longer disappears from your map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Tree Texture:[/b] A specific tree type has had its broken texture fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Removed Overexposure Issues:[/b] Bright lights no longer appear when talking to NPCs or riding around in the world. Please note lower settings may not render lighting changes as well as higher settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Nav Mesh & Collision:[/b] We have combed through the island thanks to your reports and have improved collision issues by removing invisible walls, places players get stuck, or strange nav mesh.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/51cc4fbf519668bd387a61204fd8dc49315b9302.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]No Nav Mesh on New Ride Island:[/b] High Coast Trail - the new ride island - currently has no nav mesh. This means you can fall off cliffs you normally wouldn’t be able to! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Incorrect Compendium Levels:[/b] When joining the game after the progression reset, it will appear as though your faction levels have been reset in your Compendium. This is not the case: your Compendium will display correctly once you’ve progressed through the main quest. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Weekly Goals List 6000+ Days:[/b] Rarely, Weekly Goals display the incorrect time and do not assign quests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Placeholder Horses: [/b]A few locations have placeholder horse assets: this means they do not have manes, tails, and upon closer inspection have hammers on their head.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unable to Dismount:[/b] Rarely, players are unable to dismount using “E.”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Missing Mini-Map Search Radius:[/b] Several new quests in Chapter 2 require searching. In rare cases the circular search radius on your mini-map will not appear; this can make it more difficult than intended to finish these quests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ride to X Location Not Updating:[/b] Quests with objectives to “Ride to the Fishing Village” will not update correctly if you’re already in the area. You must leave and re-enter the area before it tracks correctly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Incorrect Version Number:[/b] The main menu displays "1.0" as the version number. This is incorrect but shouldn't affect any gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3]A note on cutscenes[/h3][p]We’d like to address cinematic cut scenes. Upcoming story drops will include new quest and game content, but [b]we will not have new cinematics.[/b] We have planned our story content around cinematics, but at this stage of development new chapter cutscenes will be represented by placeholders.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Looking ahead: our roadmap
notes.content:
[p]Since the release of Equinox: Homecoming, we’ve been gathering player feedback and deploying regular patches. As we approach one month since launch, the dust is beginning to settle… and we’re happy to reveal what’s coming for the rest of the year with our first roadmap![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/b38c6ead98de4f23751027764b92650d2b84b442.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our roadmap focuses on two types of planned updates: patches and content updates. [/p][list][*][p][b]Patches[/b] are smaller updates full of improvements like bug fixes, quality of life implementations, and more. Whenever possible we try to include new content in these updates in the form of new races or ride islands. These types of patches will be similar in size and scope to our latest update Patch #4.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Content Updates[/b] focus on adding significant new game content like additional story chapters, weekly quests, races, ride island locations, and new or unique features. [/p][/*][/list][p]All of our updates include bug fixes, polish, and improvements like optimization and animation refinements. The entire team is always working on improving the game’s experience. This is a crucial and evergreen part of the game’s development![/p][h3]
A note on cutscenes and progression[/h3][p]We’d like to address cinematic cut scenes. Upcoming story drops will include new quest and game content, but [b]we will not have new cinematics.[/b] We have planned our story content around cinematics, but at this stage of development please understand new chapter cutscenes will be represented by placeholders. 
[/p][p]Whenever we drop new chapters, we plan to reset character quest progression. This means when you log back in you’ll start the game’s story anew. This is to help us ensure the experience is working as intended and to get feedback on the entire current play experience.[/p][h3]
Patch #4 - New Race & Bug Fixes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/a54e4ddb3bd5b9264fdc06e2b7900d310f97309c.png"][/img][/p][p]Last week we released our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3258290/view/528721513576138163"][u]fourth patch[/u][/url]. It included a whole slew of improvements, bug fixes, as well as a new race. We have several smaller patches planned for late summer and they’ll be similar to this patch in terms of content and breadth![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3258290/view/528721513576138163"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/9995921fddf2acc2a61a6164c8848146676bfa30.gif"][/img][/p][h3]First Content Update[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/dd681d8b50309823b411ce8053434f01bdd19179.png"][/img][/p][p]Our first content update is planned to come out early in the summer! We’ve been working hard on the next installation of the main storyline as well as a bunch of new content in the form of weeklies, races, and even a new ride island to getaway to. 
[/p][p]This first content update will also include two new systems: an upgrade system at the Ferrier to improve your gear and new daily gift quests that help increase faction reputation.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/81fb3f4443b3aca11cacb2892330f39c1d922534.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Summer Patches[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/eb6e968a471b97b941040dc427055608dd61a424.png"][/img][/p][p]We also have a couple of patches planned throughout the summer! These updates will focus on bug fixes and other improvements, but they’ll also include some new content. Take a peak at our work in progress emote system in action below… 👀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/6c04d5c0cf64996cb8e46cbc05425b6538822660.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Second Content Update[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/b64809bc0769e7abd69864ace30bbb2d2f08d9f3.png"][/img][/h3][p]Our next Content Update is scheduled to launch in Autumn. This will include the release of our Ch. 3’s quest content, a new Ride Island and Weekly Quests, plus the introduction of [b]User Generated Races![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/c75782e407d56a1f631f831a08d1166aecb2eb73.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]See you at IGN Live and Women-Led Games this weekend![/h3][p]This weekend we have a trailer debuting at [url="https://www.ign.com/live/"]IGN Live[/url] full of new game footage. You can catch it on the IGN Live stream June 8th. 🎉 There's so many different ways to watch, so[url="https://www.ign.com/articles/ign-live-2025-how-to-watch-and-what-to-expect"] learn how to catch the stream here.[/url] We're delighted to see our indie horse game up there in the big leagues! 🤩 We couldn't have done it without y'all~[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/a5f48d9cf5d547481852132a46464443d4882c4b.gif"][/img][/p][p]We are also in the [url="https://www.womenledgames.com/"]Women-Led Games[/url]: Summer Game Fest showcase from June 6-13! The livestream is begins June 7th over [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LsDFjNW8jhA"]on YouTube[/url]. We'll be debuting a developer interview during the showcase. 👀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/96c7ee5b1b37cd8f8d14482305e667904be2b7bc.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Patch #4 - New Race & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/74ffa56dce2f414e4a993f45935cbcecbfc5f7ef.png[/img]

For our fourth patch, we focused on fixing a variety of crashes to ensure the game is a more stable experience for as many people as possible. We also continued our optimization efforts by lowering texture sizes and overall performance load. In addition to bug fixes, we’ve added one new race and an accessibility feature that allows players to toggle on and off the sprint effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/33f2022cae811c9ed22ee5e191585bb36676321e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/faa85b7e212311d1838ee5f69945e3c188d8cfe0.gif[/img]

[b]New Race Track - Forest Weave:[/b] This challenging race takes you up a winding path through the forest full of tricky turns and jumps. The starting board is located right outside the Rose Manor!

[b]Sprint Motion Blur Toggle On/Off:[/b] The Sprint Effect can cause discomfort and nausea for some users. This can now be turned off from the Options menu under Gameplay Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/0b336a24bb6e6ad67469a103d20a1052a7cf5066.png[/img]

[b]More Racing Sign Posts:[/b] To make race navigation easier, we’ve added more additional sign posts to all races.

[b]Improved Error Handling:[/b] Our error messages when encountering login issues are now more descriptive and helpful for investigating bugs and issues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/2dd6671b79c35d4964929a143347cba503b9fc4d.png[/img]

[b]Graphical Polish:[/b] We’ve continued to improve our graphics by fixing a large variety of issues; examples of the most commonly reported issues we’ve fixed include…
[list]
[*] Your horse’s tail no longer stretches out during the “Warm Welcome” cutscene.
[*] Markings on the bay horses now appear white as intended.
[*] A variety of sign textures have been replaced, fixing issues where they were stretched out or displayed temporary art.
[*] Player hair colors have been corrected to display correctly. 
[*] Champagne horses no longer have a visible tail bone nub. (🚫 🦴 )
[*] Player horse colors and markings will now appear correctly in cinematics.
[*] The chat window’s scroll bar no longer lingers. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/a5f6ad3d5aadbf5413227f6cc0334317423b53da.png[/img][i]Player hair color and Bay markings have been fixed.[/i]

[b]Player Profiles Now Display the Correct Data:[/b] Incorrect player data (e.g names, levels) used to appear in player profiles; this data is now displayed correctly. 

[b]Weekly Goals Rewards Award Properly[/b]: Completing Weekly Goals now gives players the Completion Reward as intended.

[b]Ride Island Invisible Walls Removed:[/b] Nav mesh on the Ride Island has been tweaked; invisible walls that prevented player movement have been removed.

[b]Inverse Kinematics Added to Player:[/b] To improve the sense of character groundedness, we have added IK to player.

[b]Compediums Show Correct Reputation Level for Factions:[/b] Previously Faction levels displayed as one higher; this has been resolved and the correct Reputation Level can be seen in your Compendium.

[b]Horse Equipment Now Changes Stats Correctly:[/b] When equipping and swapping gear, your horse’s stats change accordingly. This UI was not updating correctly; changing equipment now updates the inventory UI stats correctly.

[b]Weekly Tasks Reset Mondays at 2am UTC:[/b] We updated when Weekly Tasks reset! Moving forward, tasks will reset every Monday at 2am UTC. The next reset will be 
Monday, June 2, 2025 at 2am UTC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/cec0097cd6e2c3febbb39907858e101b467cf5f5.png[/img]
This is not an exhaustive list. Rather, this is a list of known issues players often ask us about…
[list]
[*] Users cannot ‘Speak with Emily’ to complete the ‘Flower Basket’ quest. We’ve spent a lot of time investigating and developing a fix, but weren’t able to address the issue. We are still working on a fix!
[*] Switching to lower settings, especially from Epic or High, causes objects to load in much slower for a five minute period of time. We recommend waiting to see if the issue resolves itself; after five minutes, most users have objects load in faster as intended.
[*] The player barn icon disappears from your map until you’ve entered it for the second time.
[*] Player feet may now occasionally look uncomfortable when in specific situations (e.g standing with one foot elevated on a rock)
[*] Light brightness doesn’t display correctly at times when you are in the middle of dialogue or while riding around in the world.
[*] Players cannot select voice over options, causing all players to have a default actor that sounds more femme.
[*] Player-placed map markers are clingy and cannot be removed, only relocated.
[*] Areas occasionally suffer from moderate deforestation with missing foliage and trees.
[*] Other player’s horses eat quite loudly, especially while in town or the player barn. (How rude!)
[*] A specific tree type has a broken texture.
[*] Occasionally, when completing a race, your final time does not appear in the completion screen. This can be resolved by exiting the race and starting again from the race board.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #3 - New Character Reset Option
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/539d1cb81667d9bf77a871d1813227bd17728109.png[/img]

Our third patch is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/3ba6ca5a5f674fea51e9b356454324332dd63877.png[/img]

[b]Character Reset:[/b] We heard y'all loud and clear! One of our most requested player features so far has been the ability to start over or recreate your character or horse. We have implemented a temporary solution that allows players to restart the game with a new character during our Early Access period. After you have created a character and enter the main menu, you can select the "Character Reset" option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/6835e945b77444d8a271ee20ae8c57840cc14800.jpg[/img]

[i]If you do this, please read the warning message that appears! This will irreversibly delete your current character and wipe your progress.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/29637014df9de54d46e934e1118be5f58fc3892e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Adding Player Time-Outs:[/b] Fixed issue where players that were spending too much time in the character creator or main menu screens would have trouble connecting to the game and chat.
[*] [b]Unlimited Sprinting:[/b] We discovered that some players were getting stuck in the sprint state even if they should have run out of stamina. We have issued a fix and infinite sprint states are no longer exploitable. 
[*] [b]Horse Incorrect Names:[/b] Occasionally horses would display an incorrect name. We have identified the culprit and issued a fix. Now your horse should be properly named!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #2

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/432eae0df15a68e76dd7202247be4bef2f193f3e.png[/img]

Our second patch includes several bug fixes to improve the play experience. We are going to deploy these at 12:00 CEST today (Sunday the 11th of May.) Downtime will last approximately 30 minutes until 12:30 CEST today (Sunday the 11th of May.) Players will be unable to log-in during this time.

Thank you for your patience as we investigate issues, develop solutions, and strive to improve the experience!

notes.title: Our Approach to Early Access
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=3oXAOIAgAK4;full][/previewyoutube]
From our earliest stages of testing, involving the community has been key to our plans. Early Access was the natural next step, and we are grateful to have more folks join us on this journey. Our first day was a whirlwhind and many of you have been asking: where do we go from here?

In this developer blog, we'll share what you can expect in our Early Access build, how we'll be moving forward, and what we're already developing improvements for. Let's get into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/9418242c343a3b4e41a6922413c50d0fb1fc2a4b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/dfb6fdb2c36f8c981649270310e2536ae65d1449.png[/img]
At the launch of Early Access, the entire of the first chapter of the first Act of the game's first story arc is fully playable. This includes around two hours of gameplay complete with cinematic cut-scenes. During Early access we intend to have updates that make other chapters of the first Act available to you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/99b96c9d805b4a4f4968e67b3532c98e76665a53.gif[/img]
This area of game development is more resource heavy and time consuming to produce. It is an important part of why we want to run a good, stable early access. We plan to continue developing this content while getting feedback on both our content and approach. The team is currently polishing the Second Chapter of Act 1, preparing it for a future update in Early Access.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/69281c24234e7a4e7cdff0d3abc0d6349cfcae75.png[/img]
The game is designed as a social multiplayer experience. In addition to Riding Clubs, there are a series of weekly repeatable tasks and side quests (that will expand as we continue through the EA period) as well as a Weekly Goal system that rewards you for completing content over the course of a week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/6714bde1fc852628ce0d8c510a11f55378e9c695.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/892a66373e33968290ce648f924e50e5a0a200b6.png[/img]
There are [b]ten races[/b] available around the island. Search out the race boards scattered around the map to find them. Each race has a leaderboard; check your best times and see if you can reach the top!

You can also do all of these races as a group. If the group leader starts a race, all members of the group will get an invitation so that you can race with each other to see who wins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/5a15615fd5a1d0d0e0247ad787d340d16600e587.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/342b9306a5dbf5cdebbcf8437f7e0c0c694cc6ad.png[/img]
There are collectable items available around the island. These won't be immediately useful as the systems to put them to use will start to appear with Chapter 2, but you can start collecting them now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/749d878c60635183d075b51176b5d3b2d98c184b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/b68857d449b7acbbee67d8020867da47a51c38b5.png[/img]
You can also access the first of our new riding locations that we call [b]Scenic Rides.[/b] You can visit the pier in downtown to access this new system. These maps are designed to provide alternate riding locations for casual exploration and stunning spots that provide a picturesque location to enjoy a trail ride. We intend to continue to add new locations like this as we proceed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/1a00cd577e7b47d3ffffdd5ac5270378a3c23e9a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/52c2b0d1393a26fff4de309ccb2920f910cc96ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/f681336d89024ccc4a67fef634fa35787424fe43.png[/img]
You can expect two different types of updates as we move forward: smaller fixes and larger content drops.

We will alternate between doing regular small bug fixes / QoL updates, with larger content drops coming every few months. What do we mean by content drops? Expect things like new quests, new races, new scenic ride locations, and a few other surprising systems we aren't quite ready to talk about just yet.

With that in mind, we also need to say that we don't have a specific length planned for Early Access. How long we stay in Early Access will depend on the progress of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/350a82869820136963649af8d27f4981a37b95c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/54eb133065256311b2221d83c2cdaa257bdbdbd6.png[/img]
This is an Early Access period. There will be bugs! While we always try to ensure our release versions are as stable as possible, it will be likely that you will encounter issues - especially at this early stage. We have [url=https://discord.gg/XHEEdcZHMQ]specific sections in Discord[/url] for you to report issues and an in-game tool to quickly submit reports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/0380bae58cfbc555f6532b7675a3f200d9f39eeb.gif[/img]

This is an important element to Early Access for a studio of our size (a little over 20 folks!) Players will find issues faster and in more volume than we could ever hope to find with the QA we can do ourselves. Having more players allows us to find issues, get more information, fix them, and make the experience more polished and enjoyable with each update we do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/d69bb1693eb3938821e9301c1ae6f13c8bb074b8.png[/img]
We really want to deliver something that feels intuitive to play and looks good. While we will never be a 100% accurate horse simulation, we are striving to provide a high quality experience in this regard. So you'll see a constant flow of animation improvements for both horse and rider. The first Early Access version already has the start of these animation improvements for the riding experience. You'll see new mounting and dismounting animations. This is just the start of the animation polish that is in motion, we expect this to be an ongoing process as we continue to polish the riding gameplay experience. This was something we heard loud and clear during the previous playtests, so know that it's an area we're focusing on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/0694c026b6ff3522641a7a74f39724a21b7a44f1.png[/img]
We are a social game with a multiplayer world, so it is important for us that players have ways to express themselves. We intend to add a regular stream of new emotes and social interactions into the game. This is an area that we are currently working on and expect that this work will continue throughout the early access period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/d8a4831a5c8be3b21525d5253f8d4047068b324d.png[/img]

We're ecstatic to welcome all of you to this important stage of our development. It's been a wonderful community so far, and we hope to see that continue as we grow. There is still a long road ahead of us with lots of content to add and things to polish. This is just the beginning and we're excited to partner with the community to create the best game possible and build a game that becomes a home away from home for many years to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/ec6c97f788e66688b2eee289207f4ea475edce7c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch #1 Notes
notes.content:
Thanks to community reports, we were able to swiftly identify several bugs and issues. This hotfix has been deployed to remedy high-priority issues related to logging, disconnects, and crashes. We're honored to present the first, but certainly not the last, patch notes for [b]Equinox: Homecoming![/b]

notes.title: How do we animate horses from scratch?
notes.content:
[h2]How We Approach Horse Animations[/h2]

It’s no secret: horses are really hard to animate. Their movement is quite special because they have practically no muscles in their lower legs! It’s all just a system of spring and release through the tendons and joints. Wonky horse anatomy is everywhere from medieval drawings to modern animated TV and even video games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/1898e86ec2900712b9bfb81931710d2265bb1f38.png[/img]
[i]Horses: enamouring and stumping artists since time immorial![/i]

For our game, horses are obviously the star of the show, so we want to do better than [i]that[/i]. While working on horse animation for our game’s cutscenes, we realized that hand keying all of our animations was simply unsustainable. It required SO much time and polish from our experienced, senior animators to get right.

That's why we partnered up with[url=https://www.rune.co/] Rune Entertainment[/url] in Canada to set up a motion capture studio directly on location in a barn. This minimized our horse actor’s stress and gave us a lot of time to record valuable data to assist in animation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/3d4e1919405132026bdf7fc2df5b1afbeb60cd4a.png[/img]

What motion capture isn’t all that well suited for though is the basic gait animations for our horses’ movements. These animations need to run in a smooth, continuous loop, so the slightest real life irregularity or asymmetry would become noticeable very quickly. That's why we hand key the important cycles for walk, trot, canter and gallop.

[h2]Getting Better and Better with Iterative Design[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/1e92e47e94d547fe7a55bf594cc590b13dc2b5de.gif[/img]
[i]An example of Muybridge’s reference photo series turned into an animated sequence![/i]

To make sure that these hand-made animations would also be able to hold up to the scrutiny of horse-loving gamers, we’ve consulted with [url=https://www.themanequest.com/blog/2025/3/28/game-announcement-amp-developer-insight-equinox-homecoming-is-a-story-driven-horse-focused-mmo-that-takes-its-audience-seriously][b]Alice Ruppert from The Mane Quest[/b][/url], to help us find and fix issues in our horses’ movements. While we won’t reach the same quality AAA studios achieve, we’re very proud of our small and scrappy team’s work. In this blog, we wanted to share our process and show how we improve the look and feel of our horse animations over time with each iteration round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/a187a2045b45d25ce538a43eef38c7add9641e9f.gif[/img]
[i]On the left are older canter animations; on the right are updated versions.[/i]

First we break things down and look at an entire animation sequence frame by frame. By comparing what we have against real-life references, such as the images recorded by Eadweard Muybridge, we noticed instances of impossible leg positions and poses that were contributing to an overall subpar look for the whole motion. For example, this helped us identify and correct moments where the horse’s knees weren’t properly locked when carrying weight, or moments where the legs didn’t stretch out far enough when reaching forward. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/3221c34f93b74d408366b5c2c1d5b39acc546c17.gif[/img]
[i]And now with galloping! What do you think, can you see some improvements?[/i]

On the left are the older animations that you’ve seen in our announcement trailer and our earlier social media posts. On the right, you can see an updated version of the same animations after making changes to various poses and leg behaviors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558547/3eb82f555f93dc91cd1a83fb91fe5cf8150a5e52.gif[/img]

[h2]Listening, Learning, and Always Improving[/h2]

We love that our community is so passionate and interested in this level of detail. We’re combing through all of your comments on social media to see what feedback we can adapt and which suggestions we should consider for future iterations! We have a lot of work scheduled for the Early Access release and its planned updates after that, but we’re always happy to receive more feedback for improvements to the horse and rider animation as well.

Our game is coming to [b]Early Access on May 8th[/b] - soon you’ll be able to take the reins and begin your adventure on Alderwood Island. Thanks for all of the support and see you soon in the next dev blog! Let us know if there's any exciting topics you'd like us to cover next. 😊
